title: 출국대기실 운영 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Communication with Outside)
(1) An admitted foreigner may use a mobile phone or other portable electronic device or send and receive letters, documents, etc. in the departure waiting room.
(2) In using portable electronic devices or sending or receiving letters, documents, etc. under paragraph (1), an admitted foreigner shall not disturb the lives of other admitted foreigners or the order of the departure waiting room.
(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), where an admitted foreigner disrupts or is likely to seriously disrupt the lives of other admitted foreigners or the order of the departure waiting room, the head, etc. may, after notifying the person of the reason, restrict the use of portable electronic devices or the sending or receipt of letters, documents, etc.
